Звички, факти і розклади. Те, що відбува: Habits, facts and timetables. Things that happen regularly or are always true.
I get up at 7 every day.
For he / she / it we add -s.
Після doesn’t дієслово без -s: закінченн: After doesn’t the verb has no -s: does has already «taken» the ending.
He, she, it: in Present Simple they «hiss» with -s. Remember: -s appears either on the verb (plays) or on the auxiliary (does), but never on both.
Те, що відбувається прямо зараз або в це: Things happening right now or around this time, and also plans for the near future.
I’m staying with my aunt this week.
Without am / is / are the sentence doesn’t work.
Дієслова стану (know, like, want, believ: State verbs (know, like, want, believe) are usually not used with -ing.
Бачиш now, look або listen? Майже завжди: See now, look or listen? You almost always need Continuous. But know, want, like and love «don’t like» -ing.
Завершені дії в минулому, коли відомо, к: Finished actions in the past, when we know exactly when they happened.
V-ed або друга форма неправильного дієсл: V-ed or the second form of an irregular verb
Завершена дія в минулому: A finished action in the past
He opened the door, looked around and left.
After did always use the first form of the verb.
Минуле вже «сидить» у did. Друга форма н: The past is already «inside» did. The second form isn’t needed.
Did, як і does, забирає на себе час. Том: Did, like does, carries the tense. So after did the verb is always in its base form: Did you go? I didn’t go.
Дія, яка тривала в певний момент у минул: An action that was in progress at a certain moment in the past. Often it is the «background» for another event.
Дія в конкретний момент минулого: An action at a specific moment in the past
At 8 p.m. I was having dinner.
Тривала дія, яку перервали: A longer action that was interrupted
I was taking a shower when the phone rang.
Дві дії паралельно: Two actions at the same time
She was cooking while he was cleaning.
Довга дія, що вже тривала, ставиться в C: A long action that was already in progress goes in Continuous.
Уяви кадр з фільму: фон (was doing) і по: Imagine a scene from a film: the background (was doing) and the event that interrupts it (did). While usually goes with Continuous, when with Past Simple.
Минула дія, результат якої важливий зара: A past action whose result matters now. The time is not mentioned.
I’ve lost my keys (and still don’t have them).
We have lived here for five years.
Є конкретний час у минулому, значить Pas: There is a specific time in the past, so it’s Past Simple.
Since і for з тривалістю до тепер вимага: Since and for with a period lasting until now need Perfect.
Yesterday, last week, ago: це Past Simpl: Yesterday, last week, ago: that’s Past Simple. Ever, never, already, yet, just: that’s Present Perfect.
Два головні способи говорити про майбутн: Two main ways to talk about the future: a spontaneous decision or a plan.
Рішення в момент мовлення (will): A decision at the moment of speaking (will)
It’s cold. I’ll close the window.
Обіцянки і прогнози-думки (will): Promises and predictions based on opinion (will)
I think you’ll pass the exam.
Заздалегідь вирішений план (going to): A plan decided in advance (going to)
We’re going to buy a dog.
Прогноз за ознаками зараз (going to): A prediction based on present evidence (going to)
Look at those clouds! It’s going to rain.
After will we don’t need to.
Вирішив щойно: will. Вирішив раніше: goi: Decided just now: will. Decided earlier: going to. See evidence right now (clouds, a goal about to be scored): going to.
Маленькі слова, які показують, про що мо: Small words that show what we are talking about: something new or something already known.
конкретне, відоме або єдине: specific, known or the only one
I saw a dog (some dog) in the park.
The dog (that dog) was very big.
Без артикля: загальне у множині: No article: general statements in the plural
Важить звук, а не буква: h не читається,: The sound matters, not the letter: h is silent, so the word starts with a vowel sound.
Професія чи роль в однині потребує a / a: A job or role in the singular needs a / an.
Дивись на звук: a university (юніверсіті: Listen to the sound: a university (it starts with a «y» sound, a consonant), but an umbrella. And an hour, because the h is silent.
Як сказати «більший», «найбільший» і пор: How to say «bigger», «the biggest» and compare anything.
My brother is older than me.
Найкращий з групи: the: The best in a group: the
It’s the best day of my life.
She is as tall as her mum.
Than (for comparing) and then (next, after that) are different words.
good has its own forms: better, the best.
Короткі слова (1 склад) беруть -er / -es: Short words (1 syllable) take -er / -est, long words (3+ syllables) take more / most. Ending in -y: happy → happier → the happiest.
Речення з if: від реальних фактів до уяв: Sentences with if: from real facts to imaginary situations.
Якщо змішати червоний і синій, вийде фіо: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
If you hurry, you’ll catch the bus.
If I were you, I’d apologise.
Якби ми вийшли раніше, ми б не запізнили: If we had left earlier, we wouldn’t have missed the train.
We don’t use will after if.
Would тільки в головній частині, не післ: Would goes only in the main clause, not after if.
Правило «без will і would після if» ряту: The rule «no will or would after if» saves half the points in this topic. If I were you: this is correct for all persons.
Коли важливо, що сталося, а не хто це зр: When what happened matters more than who did it.
This phone is made in Korea.
Хочемо назвати виконавця: by: We want to name the doer: by
Harry Potter was written by J. K. Rowling.
You need the third form: build → built.
You can’t form the passive without be.
Знайди be і подивись на його час: is / a: Find be and check its tense: is / are (now), was / were (past), will be (future). The second part is always V3.
